description: This file defines the EmployeeReportingMethodDao class, a Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for managing 'ReportTo' entities related to employee reporting structures in the HRM system. It includes methods for saving, searching, deleting, and retrieving reporting relationships between employees, with support for pagination and count operations.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing employee reporting relationships within the HRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Persists a ReportTo entity, representing an employee's reporting relationship, to the database.

methods.name: searchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of immediate supervisors for an employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSupervisorPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for querying supervisor relationships, used internally for search operations.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for querying subordinate relationships, used internally for search operations.

methods.name: getSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of immediate supervisors matching the search criteria.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSupervisors
methods.description: Deletes supervisor relationships for a given employee based on IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Deletes subordinate relationships for a given employee based on IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSubordinates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for an employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of subordinates matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Fetches a specific ReportTo entity for given supervisor and subordinate employee IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSubordinateIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Finds subordinate IDs for a supervisor among a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getExistingSupervisorIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Finds supervisor IDs for a subordinate among a given list of IDs.
